verdict.rationale: The Guichet unique documents a remote sign-in path through FranceConnect+, which can replace the advanced-signature requirement, and states that filings need no in-person visit ("pas de déplacement"). The alternative path, a qualified e-signature certificate, is a credential issued by a certification body. Neither source says what the factors are, so we cannot confirm this is credential MFA rather than biometric liveness, an in-person check, or a mailed PIN. Missing for 10: documentation of FranceConnect+'s authentication factors, evidence that obtaining the qualified certificate needs no in-person or postal step, and hands-on corroboration that an authorized human can complete sign-in fully remotely.

support.subject: As an AI-native founder, the published sign-in path is credential MFA an authorized human can complete remotely — not biometric liveness, an in-person visit, or a PIN by physical mail
